title: Flex-point cover: upper bound 8 verified; equality not certified (30003711)
body:
The new construction establishes **ordinary section genus at most 8** for the nine-flex cover over the smooth cubic coefficient space. Separate independent finite-group and topology audits clear that upper bound.

The submitted equality 8 is **not independently certified**. Its inspected Chen--Wan arXiv v2 lower-bound proof relies on a degree-seven constant-F3 nonzero map that is actually zero by an explicit Heisenberg-group cochain and Poincare duality. A separate fresh reconstruction identifies the missing spectral-sequence differential. Convention and ring-transcription corrections do not repair that detector, and a verified replacement lower-bound proof has not been recovered.

The actual 2025 journal article has later revisions, but its proof body was not obtained. This finding does not establish genus below 8 or falsify the published theorem. It identifies the precise missing verification in this PR. The earlier AI acceptances are preserved as historical evidence rather than continuing mathematical clearance.

The stronger literal OWR connected/full-nine-sheet formulation and exact algorithmic branching count are not resolved by this PR. No solved-result preprint, Zenodo DOI or tracker row was produced for this PR. AI tools were used extensively; no completed conventional human peer review or formal certification is claimed.

[Full audit and evidence](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/98ee5482ef3352b81758c1590a7685947eec3725/draft_pr_claimed_solved_800_900_20261012/audits/pr833_30003711/INTEGRATED_AUDIT.md). [Original frozen submission](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/tree/0e6e23213494ecb4a7208f920d25d7b49502a5cb/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30003711).
comment:
Closing without merging after adversarial review of head `0e6e23213494ecb4a7208f920d25d7b49502a5cb`. The submitted exact genus-eight claim is not independently certified from its inspected lower-bound dependency.

The new **upper bound at most eight** passed separate finite-group and topology audits. Exact replay checked all 216 Hessian-group elements, including the 56 fixed-flex-free elements, and the orbit-neighborhood/eight-domain construction is valid for ordinary section genus. That meaningful partial result is preserved.

The gap is the matching lower bound. [Chen--Wan arXiv v2, Proposition 4.2(1)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2306.17303v2), used to prove its Theorem 4.1, asserts that the characteristic map `c:PU3/K -> BK` is nonzero on constant-F3 degree-seven cohomology. Two independent adversarial reconstructions instead prove that this entire map is **zero**:

- The actual lift of K to SU3 is the order 27 Heisenberg group H with abelianization K, so c* is an isomorphism on H1.
- In coordinates `(a,b,t)(d,e,s)=(a+d,b+e,t+s+bd)`, the explicit cochain `f=t-ab` has `delta f(g,h)=a(g)b(h)`. Thus c*(yy')=0.
- Every degree-seven class of `H*(BK;F3)=exterior(y,y') tensor F3[x,x']` annihilates the pulled-back H1. Poincare duality on the closed oriented 8-manifold PU3/K forces its image to vanish.

Exact cochain/rank checks pass in normal and optimized modes. An independent Leary-ring calculation also identifies the omitted differential killing the proposed class. Correcting conventions or the printed ring typo, or choosing another constant-F3 degree-seven class for this same map, does not repair the proof.

The final 2025 journal article has later 2024 revisions. Its proof body was not obtained through normal public access, and no verified replacement lower-bound proof was recovered in the bounded source checks. **This review does not prove genus below eight and does not declare the published theorem false.** A correct final or alternative lower-bound proof could still establish equality.

The remaining repair requires a substantive verified lower-bound argument; asserting a possible twisted-coefficient detector is insufficient. An upper-bound-only revision would not prove the submitted claimed solution. Accordingly no solved-result preprint, Zenodo deposit or DOI tracker row has been created for this PR.

[Integrated audit](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/98ee5482ef3352b81758c1590a7685947eec3725/draft_pr_claimed_solved_800_900_20261012/audits/pr833_30003711/INTEGRATED_AUDIT.md), [repair assessment](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/98ee5482ef3352b81758c1590a7685947eec3725/draft_pr_claimed_solved_800_900_20261012/audits/pr833_30003711/REPAIR_ASSESSMENT.md), [independent dependency proof](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/98ee5482ef3352b81758c1590a7685947eec3725/draft_pr_claimed_solved_800_900_20261012/audits/pr833_30003711/lower_bound_audit_01/REPORT.md), and [fresh spectral-sequence/disposition review](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/98ee5482ef3352b81758c1590a7685947eec3725/draft_pr_claimed_solved_800_900_20261012/audits/pr833_30003711/spectral_sequence_audit_01/REPORT.md). These are extensive AI audits, with no completed conventional human review or formal verification claimed. The stronger literal OWR connected/full-nine-sheet invariant is not resolved by this PR.
